      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Load CSV files with exact names\n",
        "trades = pd.read_csv('historical_data.csv', encoding='utf-8')\n",
        "sentiment = pd.read_csv('fear_greed.csv', encoding='utf-8')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Check column names\n",
        "print(\"Historical columns:\", trades.columns)\n",
        "print(\"Sentiment columns:\", sentiment.columns)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert dates to datetime\n",
        "trades['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(trades['timestamp'], errors='coerce')\n",
        "sentiment['date'] = pd.to_datetime(sentiment['date'], errors='coerce')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove time for merging\n",
        "trades['Date'] = trades['timestamp'].dt.date\n",
        "sentiment['Date'] = sentiment['date'].dt.date\n",
        "\n",
        "# Merge datasets\n",
        "merged = pd.merge(trades, sentiment[['Date', 'classification']], on='Date', how='left')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Show first rows\n",
        "print(merged.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Average profit/loss\n",
        "avg_profit = merged.groupby('classification')['closed pnl'].mean()\n",
        "print(\"\\nAverage Profit/Loss by Market Sentiment:\")\n",
        "print(avg_profit)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Winning trades\n",
        "merged['Win'] = merged['closed pnl'] > 0\n",
        "win_count = merged.groupby('classification')['Win'].sum()\n",
        "loss_count = merged.groupby('classification')['Win'].apply(lambda x: (~x).sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nWinning Trades:\", win_count)\n",
        "print(\"Losing Trades:\", loss_count)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Total trades\n",
        "trade_count = merged['classification'].value_counts()\n",
        "print(\"\\nTotal Trades by Sentiment:\", trade_count)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Charts\n",
        "avg_profit.plot(kind='bar', title='Average Profit/Loss by Market Sentiment')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Average Profit/Loss')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "win_count.plot(kind='bar', color='green', title='Winning Trades by Market Sentiment')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Number of Winning Trades')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "loss_count.plot(kind='bar', color='red', title='Losing Trades by Market Sentiment')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Number of Losing Trades')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "trade_count.plot(kind='bar', color='blue', title='Total Trades by Market Sentiment')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Number of Trades')\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

              "      };\n",
              "\n",
              "      let percentDone = fileData.byteLength === 0 ?\n",
              "          100 :\n",
              "          Math.round((position / fileData.byteLength) * 100);\n",
              "      percent.textContent = `${percentDone}% done`;\n",
              "\n",
              "    } while (position < fileData.byteLength);\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  // All done.\n",
              "  yield {\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'complete',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "scope.google = scope.google || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab = scope.google.colab || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab._files = {\n",
              "  _uploadFiles,\n",
              "  _uploadFilesContinue,\n",
              "};\n",
              "})(self);\n",
              "</script> "
            ]

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "\n",
        "# Load files\n",
        "trades = pd.read_csv('historical_data.csv')\n",
        "sentiment = pd.read_csv('fear_greed_index.csv')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert trader timestamp (milliseconds)\n",
        "trades['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(trades['Timestamp'], unit='ms')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert sentiment date\n",
        "sentiment['date'] = pd.to_datetime(sentiment['date'])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create date-only columns\n",
        "trades['Date'] = trades['Timestamp'].dt.date\n",
        "sentiment['Date'] = sentiment['date'].dt.date\n",
        "\n",
        "# Merge both datasets\n",
        "merged = pd.merge(\n",
        "    trades,\n",
        "    sentiment[['Date', 'classification']],\n",
        "    on='Date',\n",
        "    how='left'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Check whether Fear/Greed values are coming\n",
        "print(merged['classification'].value_counts())"
      ],
